Tracking bead for the absorption end-state documented in README.md, docs/plan/plan.md (Phase 6) and docs/notes/security-model.md: warden is the interim standalone form of a SEAM capability. Until now nothing tracked that end-state, so the acknowledged stopgaps (shared-secret caller allowlist, no per-agent attribution, no per-agent revocation) had no path to closure. This bead closes when warden's standalone deployment is retired behind SEAM.

## Absorption steps

issue.description:
The documented org ceiling is evaluated read-before-write: the server lists pools, policy sums Σ UpperBound(other pools) against the requested count, then warden patches Spot. Two concurrent scale requests can both pass against the same snapshot and both apply, leaving the summed upper bounds above the org ceiling — the one guarantee warden exists to enforce. Close the window: serialize scale handling (per-instance mutex/single-flight) and/or use the Spot CRD's resourceVersion as an optimistic concurrency check on the patch (re-read + compare, deny or retry on conflict). Add a test proving N concurrent allowed requests can never push the total past MAX_TOTAL_NODES, and record the chosen mechanism in docs/notes/invariant-policy.md.

---
Priority: P1
Created by: weave strand
issue.notes:
Adopted and finished the previous attempt's uncommitted working-tree work (it timed out before committing), reviewed every hunk, and verified the design end to end.

Mechanism (two layers, recorded in docs/notes/invariant-policy.md 'Concurrency'):
1. Single-flight (primary): the whole read->evaluate->write sequence in scalePool runs under one org-wide sync.Mutex (scaleMu), held across retries. Sufficient for the deployed topology (replicas: 1, warden holds the org's only Spot credential).
2. resourceVersion precondition (defense in depth): ScaleNodePool now takes the snapshot's resourceVersion and echoes it in patch metadata; 409 -> ErrConflict -> re-list, re-decide against fresh state (deny if cap no longer fits), retry up to maxScaleAttempts=4, fail closed with audited deny. An upstream that rejects RV-carrying patches outright (400/422) -> ErrPreconditionRejected -> one precondition-free retry, leaving layer 1 as the guarantee. Whether the live ngpc API exposes/honors resourceVersion is NOT verifiable from this box (no Spot CRDs in-cluster; ngpc API is external and credentialed) - follow-up probe noted in the doc.

Tests: TestConcurrentScaleNeverExceedsOrgCeiling (20 concurrent individually-allowed scales against a deliberately CAS-free fake upstream; asserts summed upper bounds never cross the cap mid-flight or finally); TestScaleRetriesAfterConflictWithFreshSnapshot; TestScaleConflictExhaustedFailsClosed; TestScaleRetriesWithoutPreconditionWhenRejected; TestNoPreconditionSentWhenUpstreamHasNoRV; plus client-level RV/conflict/precondition tests in internal/spot.
